yoast_head_json.title: Privacy Policy - eCom Gliders
yoast_head_json.og_description: Privacy Policy Effective Date: 01-Jan-2025 At Ecom Gliders, your privacy is important to us. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you visit our website, use our services, or interact with our team. 1. Information We Collect We may collect the following types of information: • Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number, billing address, and any other details you voluntarily provide when contacting us or signing up for services. • Business Information: Your Amazon seller account details, store name, ASINs, advertising data, product listings, and performance metrics you share with us. • Technical Information: IP address, browser type, device details, referral sources, and browsing behavior on our website. • Payment Information: For invoicing and processing payments, we may collect billing details. We do not store credit card numbers; payments are handled through secure third-party processors (Stripe). 2. How We Use Your Information We use your information to: • Provide and manage our Amazon agency services • Communicate with you about your account or inquiries • Improve our website, services, and client experience • Analyze data to optimize your Amazon performance • Send important updates, newsletters, or marketing (you can opt out anytime) • Comply with legal obligations 3. Information Sharing We do not sell, rent, or trade your personal or business data. We only share your information in the following cases: • With trusted third-party tools and partners who help us provide our services (e.g., analytics platforms, advertising tools, invoicing software) • When required by law, court order, or to protect our legal rights • With your explicit permission 4. Data Security We take data protection seriously. Your information is stored securely and protected using industry-standard security measures. While no online system is 100% secure, we strive to safeguard your data against unauthorized access, misuse, or loss. 5. Your Rights You have the right to: • Access the personal data we hold about you • Request correction or deletion of your data • Withdraw consent for marketing communications at any time • Ask us to stop processing your data (subject to legal or contractual obligations) To make any such request, please contact us at info@ecomgliders.com. 6. Cookies and Tracking Our website may use cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance user experience and analyze website traffic. You can adjust your browser settings to refuse cookies, but this may affect site functionality. 7. Third-Party Links Our site may contain links to external websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices or content of those sites. Please review their privacy policies before submitting any data. 8. Updates to This Policy We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with a revised effective date. 9. Contact Us If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or how your data is handled, contact us at: eCom GlidersEmail: info@ecomgliders.comPhone: +1 (360) 660 1210Address: 1209 Mountain Road Pl NE 5913, Albuquerque, NM 87110

Using Our Services To work together successfully, we need your cooperation. Once payment is made, no refunds will be issued under any circumstances. If you wish to cancel a subscription or recurring service, you must notify us at least 24 hours before the next billing cycle. Cancellations requested after a charge has been processed will not qualify for a refund. We encourage you to contact us in advance if you have any questions about which service best suits your needs. Our Work & Ownership Until your payment is complete, all creatives, copy, and strategies we develop remain our property. Once full payment is made, you’ll own the final delivered materials — unless we’ve agreed otherwise. Please don’t share, reuse, or resell our work without our permission. Privacy & Confidentiality We take your privacy seriously. Any information you share with us is kept confidential and will only be used to complete your services. We will never sell your data or use it outside of your project. No Guarantees We work hard to deliver the best results possible, but due to the ever-changing nature of Amazon, we can’t guarantee specific outcomes. We’re not liable for: • Lost sales or profits • Account issues caused by Amazon’s internal policies • Third-party tool delays or errors Canceling Services You or we can end a project with written notice (e.g., 14 days). If you cancel early, any unpaid work up to that point will still be billed. We may also pause or stop service if these terms are violated or if payment is not received. Updates to These Terms These Terms & Conditions may be updated from time to time. Any changes will be posted right here, so you’re always in the loop. Need Help?
